enrichment.summary: Hertz Environmental will prepare the storm water pollution prevention plan and file the required notice, collect water samples during rain events, and submit lab results and action reports for the East Oakland Pride Elementary School Site Improvements Project. The cap of $8,250 includes up to $2,000 for additional services. Work is scheduled from May 23 to December 23, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The district is buying 77 existing Teknion Leverage workstations from Building Block Interiors, Inc. of Fremont, and the company will install them during normal business hours. The furniture is for the Central Office Consolidation Move Project and is paid from the Measure Y building fund. Delivery is set between May 23 and August 31, 2024.

enrichment.summary: This change order pays Arntz Builders, Inc. for extra construction work on the new two-story building for district staff at the Cole Campus Central Administration Center. enrichment.summary: The district is hiring Nor Cal Moving Services of Hayward to move free-standing furniture from the first floor to the second floor at 1011 Union Street, Oakland. This is part of the Central Office Consolidation Move Project. The move is scheduled for May 23, 2024.

enrichment.headline: Sets Overaa Construction's Roosevelt Middle School modernization Phase 1 price at $3,671,887
enrichment.summary: This amendment to the lease-leaseback contract with Overaa Construction sets the Total Sublease Amount for Phase 1 of the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project at $3,671,887.00. The amount includes allowances for items such as electrical service work, site preparation, pre-construction services and security, plus contractor and district contingencies. The text does not state how much this adds to the earlier amount, and all other contract terms stay the same.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
